request: i want to create a new mode for Module_Receiving called "By Receiver"  This will share the same guided workflow as "Guided" but instead of entering a PO number the user will get a table of the last # of receivers entered into visual, showing 1) Receiver Number, 2) PO #, 3) Line #, 4) Part Number, 5) Vendor, 6) Location Received to, 7) Qty Received, 8) Qty Ordered, 9) Qty Remaining on Line.  They should also be able to enter a Receiver number into a search box and have the list filter to that Receiver.  Once a line on the table is selected take all the required information that the following guided steps require and pass them forward.  The table of receivers should always be ordered by date received in, never show receivers that do not contain part numbers, only contain receivers where inventory is being added, never removed from the system.  ask ?s

decisions.decision: The receiver list is a new workflow step, ReceiverSelection = 12, hosted like PO Entry
decisions.why: Back from Load Entry routes by step, and the visibility switch, back-button rule and header bar all read steps
decisions.rejected: a flag on POEntry that swaps its content

decisions.decision: The entry mode is recorded on Service_ReceivingWorkflow as IsByReceiverFlow
decisions.why: after a row is chosen the step is LoadEntry, which IsGuidedWalkStep already claims for Guided, so both chips would light up
decisions.rejected: deriving the mode from a non-empty receiver number

decisions.why: Model_InforVisualPart.RemainingQuantity is an int and has nowhere to put vendor, date or receiver number

decisions.decision: One SQL query performs the joins, grouping, filters and remaining clamp
decisions.why: every exclusion in the spec is a source-side rule and the search must never re-surface an excluded row
decisions.rejected: reading raw lines and grouping in C#

decisions.decision: The query reads a 1000-row window; the view model searches and pages over it
decisions.why: the request asks for the last number of receivers, so a window is the requirement, and filtering 1000 rows stays inside the one-second budget
decisions.rejected: passing the search term into SQL on every keystroke

decisions.decision: Receivers with no RECEIVED_DATE are excluded
decisions.why: the list is ordered by received date and the receiving-analytics query already requires a received date

decisions.decision: New Dao_InforVisualReceiver carrying the ApplicationIntent=ReadOnly guard
decisions.why: follows the one-DAO-per-surface split and keeps the guard in the constructor
decisions.rejected: adding the query to the 92 KB Dao_InforVisualConnection

decisions.decision: Load Entry shows Qty Remaining on Line read-only
decisions.why: Load Entry captures only location and load count, and adding a quantity input would change the walks validation and save path
decisions.rejected: seeding NumberOfLoads from the remaining quantity

decisions.decision: dev:PagerControl with page sizes 25, 50, 100, 200 opening on 50
decisions.why: spec assumptions pin the counts and the default
decisions.rejected: matching Edit Mode page sizes of 20, 50, 100, 200

decisions.decision: The selected row key lives on the workflow service
decisions.why: view models are transient, so the rebuilt list cannot remember its own selection
decisions.rejected: keeping the list view model alive across steps

decisions.decision: Stored default token is by-receiver, recognised in StartWorkflowAsync, NormalizeDefaultMode and both settings view models
decisions.why: an unrecognised stored value is rewritten to guided, so a missing normaliser silently undoes the choice

decisions.decision: The header step bar is built for the walk that was entered
decisions.why: leaving Enter PO as step one would tell the operator they skipped a screen they never had
decisions.rejected: hiding the step bar in by-receiver mode

decisions.decision: The mock-data path returns sample receivers
decisions.why: a method that returns empty under the existing development toggle would make the mode look broken

decisions.decision: Append ReceiverSelection = 12 and host it like POEntry
decisions.why: Back from Load Entry routes by step, and the visibility switch and header bar already read a step
decisions.rejected: A flag on POEntry that swapped its content, which every step predicate would then have to consult

decisions.decision: Record the entry mode on the service as IsByReceiverFlow
decisions.why: After a row is chosen the step is LoadEntry, which IsGuidedWalkStep already claims for Guided
decisions.rejected: Deriving the mode from a non-empty receiver number, which couples mode identity to data a later step could clear

decisions.decision: Rank with ROW_NUMBER inside a CTE and take TOP (@MaxRows) from the rank
decisions.why: TOP over a grouped query with an outer ORDER BY returns an arbitrary window, and the requirement is the newest rows
decisions.rejected: SELECT TOP (@MaxRows) with the ORDER BY on the outer query, which does not bound the window to the newest

decisions.decision: Restore the row highlight from SelectedReceiverKey on the workflow service
decisions.why: The list view model is transient, so it cannot remember its own selection across a step change
decisions.rejected: Keeping the list view model alive across steps, which breaks transient registration

decisions.decision: Use Xvfb. none. Covered by the row above.
Group the receipt lines per receiver and part and take every line detail from the first PO line found
decisions.why: FR-008 requires one row per receiver and part, and grouping on warehouse or location split a part across rows
decisions.rejected: Grouping by every displayed column, which let a part received into two locations appear twice

plan.summary: Plan and design artifacts written for a By Receiver mode built on a new ReceiverSelection step, one read-only MTMFG query and a fifth shell chip
plan.key_finding: The receiving walk derives its active mode from the step, so a by-receiver walk looks like Guided once it reaches Load Entry unless the entry mode is recorded on the service.

specify.summary: Shipped the By Receiver mode: a read-only Infor Visual receiver query behind a guarded DAO, a searched and paged list view model and view, the workflow state that carries a chosen row into Load Entry with Back returning to the highlighted row, the fifth shell chip, and the stored by-receiver default.

approach: Add ReceiverSelection to the workflow step enum, read recent inventory receipts from one new read-only Infor Visual query behind a new DAO, show them in a paged searchable list view model hosted like PO Entry, and carry the chosen row into the existing walk at Load Entry.
